voice-search-command.name: Voice search
voice-search-command.description: Search by speaking. Press the microphone, say your search and end with the trigger word. Whisper runs in the browser, so the audio stays on the device.

transparency.label: Where your voice goes
transparency.description: The browser records the microphone and Whisper turns the audio into text on the visitor's device. This server never receives audio, only the finished search. It downloads the model and runtime once from the hosts below, and browsers load them from this instance.

triggerWord.label: Trigger word
triggerWord.description: Say it last to run the search, as in "adam sandler search". Voice search drops it from the query. It can be more than one word.

language.label: Language
language.description: Two-letter code such as en, it or de. Leave blank to use the page language. English-only models such as whisper-base.en ignore it.

silenceSeconds.label: Seconds of silence before it stops
silenceSeconds.description: With 0 it keeps listening until someone presses the microphone again.

searchOnSilence.label: Search when listening stops
searchOnSilence.description: When listening stops after silence, search what it heard, even without the trigger word.

livePreview.label: Show words while speaking
livePreview.description: Transcribes the phrase while the visitor is still talking. Slow devices feel the extra work.

pauseMs.label: Milliseconds of quiet that end a phrase
pauseMs.description: After this pause Whisper transcribes the phrase and voice search checks it for the trigger word.

maxPhraseSeconds.label: Longest phrase in seconds
maxPhraseSeconds.description: Voice search cuts longer speech here. Whisper takes at most 30 seconds at a time.

vadThreshold.label: Speech threshold
vadThreshold.description: How many times louder than the background noise counts as speech. Raise it in noisy rooms.

model.label: Speech model
model.description: A Whisper model in transformers.js ONNX format. whisper-tiny is the fastest, whisper-base is the default, whisper-small is the most accurate and the largest. Models ending in .en only understand English. Find models lists them.

revision.label: Model revision
revision.description: Branch, tag or commit. The default is a pinned commit of the default model. Leave it blank or pick another model to use the latest commit on main.

gpuEncoderDtype.label: WebGPU encoder precision
gpuEncoderDtype.description: The model needs this file, for example onnx/encoder_model.onnx for fp32. On WebGPU, Whisper's encoder loses accuracy below fp32.

modelHost.label: Model download host
modelHost.description: This server downloads the model from here once. Any host with the Hugging Face layout works, a mirror too.

runtimeHost.label: Runtime download host
runtimeHost.description: An npm CDN that serves package@version/path, such as cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm or unpkg.com.

ortVersion.label: onnxruntime-web version
ortVersion.description: Leave blank to use the version transformers.js depends on.

checksums.label: Runtime checksums
checksums.description: One file name and SHA-256 per line. The server refuses a download that doesn't match. The defaults match the default versions, so update or clear them when you change a version. The server doesn't check files missing from the list.

waveColors.label: Wave colours
waveColors.description: Up to 6 CSS colours or variables, separated by commas. Leave blank to use the theme's brand colours.

fieldsets.model: Speech model, runs in the browser

dtype.q8: q8, a quarter of the size

notices.noModels: No models found. Type owner/repo instead.
